itens.trecho: Consegue ombrear com o original. Gostei bastante deste filme, na medida em que me pareceu uma sequela que honra e ombreia com o filme original. Neste filme, Freddy Krueger volta a atacar os sonhos dos adolescentes de Elm Street, mas os adolescentes, desta vez, são capazes de lhe dar luta.

"A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors" is an extremely engaging film despite the fact that it is in the very nature of sequels that each new entry in any franchise won't match the rapidly declining standard set by the previous film and none of them will ever be as good as the original anyway because the format is bound to be played out and looking…

My favorite out of the entire series. Nothing like going after a bunch of teens who are locked up in a psychiatric hospital for bad nightmares. Freddy has a field day with this one. Welcome to prime time bitch!
